stories.title: Dustin Johnson & Cameron Smith Make Major Decisions on Golf Futures

stories.quickRead: Dustin Johnson and Cameron Smith accepted special-status agreements with the DP World Tour that will give them invitations into a limited number of DP World Tour events in 2027, restoring a competitive pathway after LIV Golf’s collapse.  The move positions both major champions to play meaningful starts in Europe next season and could shape how they rebuild schedules, rankings opportunities, and major access with their PGA Tour futures still unsettled.

stories.title: Bryson keeps poking the PGA Tour question
stories.summary: It is safe to say LIV acted as a safety net for Bryson DeChambeau until it collapsed early this month.
stories.quickRead: Bryson DeChambeau has rejoined the DP World Tour for the 2027 season, filing before the deadline and receiving Category 1 membership that guarantees entry into any event he chooses.  The move gives him a full top-tier schedule after LIV’s collapse while he potentially faces a 12-month PGA Tour suspension, making Europe his clearest path to regular starts and big events next year.

stories.quickRead: An insider flatly said Tiger Woods “will never give up” on trying to return, insisting no surgery, injury or setback will convince him to walk away from competitive golf.  The point matters now because Woods has announced he’s coming back in December at the Hero World Challenge after more than two years away, putting real pressure on his body to hold up over 72 holes.
